item.title: Gen 6 Glock, what it could be
item.description: What might the Gen 6 be. Larry Vicker's thoughts and pros and cons.

item.title: The Caliber Cluster
item.description: Let’s dive into the absolute train wreck that is the U.S. military’s small arms and ammo situation, specifically with the Army SOF.

item.title: Glock’s Big Shake-Up and What It Means for the Future of the Platform
item.description: The firearms grapevine has been lighting up like a full-auto demo at the range. Just when we were all chewing on those Gen 6 whispers, Glock drops a bombshell that's got the whole community buzzing: they're streamlining their lineup hard.

item.title: CZ 75 at 50: Why Larry Vickers Still Calls It the Greatest Wonder-Nine Ever Made (2025 50th Anniversary Limited Edition Review)
item.description: Larry Vickers celebrates 50 years of the legendary CZ 75. Discover why the low-bore-axis, steel-frame wonder-nine remains one of the most accurate, soft-shooting, and copied pistols ever—plus full details on the limited 2025 50th Anniversary full-size and compact models.

item.title: Staccato HD – The First 2011 I’d Actually Bet My Life On
item.description: A few years ago the old STI company was circling the drain, bleeding market share to CZ, Walther, and anyone else who could actually ship a reliable double-stack 9mm.

item.title: Bundeswehr Selects CZ P-10 C as New Standard Sidearm: P13 Contract Awarded to Česká Zbrojovka
item.description: Česká Zbrojovka (CZ) has won a major international tender to supply the German Bundeswehr with its new standard service pistol, the P13, based on the CZ P-10 C OR model in Flat Dark Earth finish. This marks a significant milestone for the Czech firearms manufacturer.

item.title: Nightforce Optics: The New Heavyweight Champ of Tactical Scopes | Larry Vickers
item.description: Larry Vickers reviews the Nightforce ATACR 1-8x24 F1 S-VPS Kit – USSOCOM's top LPVO. Discover why Nightforce has surpassed Schmidt & Bender in tactical scopes with rugged build.

item.title: Red Dot Sights on Pistols: Why They're Here to Stay | Larry Vickers
item.description: Larry Vickers explains why red dot sights (RDS) are essential for pistols, especially for aging eyes, dynamic shooting, and duty use. From Aimpoint ACRO P-2 to Holosun EPS and Trijicon RMR HD—pros, cons, and maintenance tips.

item.title: Evolution: The Vickers M7 NGSW Sling for the SIG M7 and Companion GPMG
item.description: Discover why quick-adjust two-point slings like the Vickers Combat Applications Sling excel for carbines. Larry Vickers explains the pitfalls of single/three-point designs and spotlights the padded Vickers M7 NGSW Sling for the SIG M7 rifle and M250 GPMG.

item.title: The Legend Lives On: Jimmy Lile and the Lile Model FB Knives – Randall Model 18 on Steroids | Larry Vickers
item.description: Discover Jimmy Lile's legendary Rambo First Blood knives, now faithfully produced by Vaughn Neeley at Lile Knives. The Lile Model FB series upgrades the classic Randall Model 18 survival knife with CPM 154CM steel and modern craftsmanship.
